blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: spUSDT retains upstream Tether freeze exposure: asset() on the Ethereum vault returned native USDT and asset() on Arbitrum returned USDT0 at pinned blocks 26095794 and 510584053 on 2026-10-01. Spark also documents full USDS economic backing and downstream strategy deployment, so USDT is the deposit asset rather than the only reserve exposure.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: spUSDT has canonical local Spark ERC-4626 issuance on Ethereum, Arbitrum and X Layer; no bridge control mints spUSDT representations. Spark Receiver-to-Executor paths administer local vaults through cross-chain governance rather than bridging spUSDT. Arbitrum and X Layer deposit assets are USDT0, a separate LayerZero lock-and-mint representation of Ethereum USDT. The USDT0 owner Safe is a collateral-bridge failure domain, not a spUSDT minter. LayerZero DVN configuration and rate limits were not independently enumerated; the collateral dependency remains external-lock-mint.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Pharos mint/bridge boundary migration; verified susdt-spark research finding

protocols.name: Spark Vaults V2 cross-chain governance
protocols.note: All three authored spUSDT deployments use native local share issuance. The Arbitrum Spark Receiver-to-Executor path and the X Layer Receiver 0x4bd50b9c00ae19e8b59723f27645c7a5cce7a4a0 targeting Executor 0xcf5af6f53cec74b791cb4182ac778ca9cd323510 resolve their L1 authority to SubProxy 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4. This governance transport administers local vaults and does not mint bridged spUSDT representations.

protocols.name: USDT0 LayerZero OFT collateral route
protocols.note: USDT0 is collateral for the Arbitrum and X Layer spUSDT vaults, not a spUSDT representation. The previously reviewed Ethereum-to-Arbitrum OFT route is retained. At X Layer block 72069446, asset() on the local spUSDT vault returned USDT0 0x779ded0c9e1022225f8e0630b35a9b54be713736, whose owner() returned the same USDT0 Safe 0x4dff9b5b0143e642a3f63a5bcf2d1c328e600bf8.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical Ethereum spUSDT issuance. At Ethereum block 25771061 (2026-08-16 23:57:35 UTC), the vault implementation was 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455, the EIP-1967 admin slot was zero, asset() returned USDT 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7, and verified SparkVault deposit() and mint() pulled the underlying before minting shares after the deposit-cap check. No bridge control carries the spUSDT claim.

Canonical Arbitrum spUSDT issuance. At Arbitrum block 495303977 (2026-08-16 00:01:22 UTC), the vault implementation was 0x282dafe8b97e2db5053761a4601ab2e1cb976318, the EIP-1967 admin slot was zero, asset() returned USDT0 0xfd086bc7cd5c481dcc9c85ebe478a1c0b69fcbb9, and the deposit cap was 250,000,000 USDT0 (6 decimals). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was Spark Executor 0x65d946e533748a998b1f0e430803e39a6388f7a1; SETTER_ROLE and TAKER_ROLE were reserve-liquidity/rate controls, not arbitrary share minters. At block 495305504, Receiver 0x212871A1C235892F86cAB30E937e18c94AEd8474 returned L1 authority SubProxy 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4 and target Executor 0x65d946e533748a998b1f0e430803e39a6388f7a1; Executor delay() was 0 with a 604800-second grace period, not a timelock. USDT0's LayerZero route is a collateral dependency and not a bridged spUSDT representation; no bridge control carries the spUSDT claim.

Spark documents X Layer as a local ERC-4626 spUSDT vault over USDT0. At block 72069446, the contract returned name Spark Savings USDT, symbol spUSDT, decimals 6, implementation 0xdce929a335c75a1676ef5957a4d7a3b928c48820, zero EIP-1967 admin slot and asset USDT0 0x779ded0c9e1022225f8e0630b35a9b54be713736. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE had one member, Spark Executor 0xcf5af6f53cec74b791cb4182ac778ca9cd323510, with delay()=0; Receiver 0x4bd50b9c00ae19e8b59723f27645c7a5cce7a4a0 targeted that Executor and returned L1 SubProxy authority. Governance transport and the USDT0 collateral bridge are distinct from local spUSDT issuance.
